H1.question: Does OPTIMADE serve MP's GGA/GGA+U-relaxed cells (as the fixture header claims) or r2SCAN-relaxed cells?
H1.verdict: CONFIRMED (the cells are smaller because they are r2SCAN-relaxed, not PBE). MP's OPTIMADE builder copies the materials-collection structure, and the materials builder ranks run types r2SCAN 5 > SCAN 4 > GGA+U 3 > GGA 2 > PBEsol 1 when choosing that structure. 12 of 13 fixture ids have an r2SCAN thermo entry. The exception is mp-1048 (NiTi), which has no r2SCAN entry. For the four ids with archived GGA-era pages, the served conventional a is 0.87-1.21% below MP's own GGA value: Cu 3.5774 vs 3.6213 (-1.21%), Ni 3.4752 vs 3.5058 (-0.87%), AlNi 2.8597 vs 2.8879 (-0.98%), AlFe 2.8455 vs 2.8743 (-1.00%). So the label 'MP's PBE-relaxed cells' is wrong for those 12 ids. The formation energies the app pairs with them, _mp_stability['gga_gga+u'], are GGA numbers for GGA structures, so cells and energies come from different functionals.
evidence: https://docs.materialsproject.org/downloading-data/using-the-api/querying-data.md ('contains structures relaxed with the PBE, PBE+U, and r2scan functionals')
https://docs.materialsproject.org/methodology/materials-methodology/calculation-details/r2scan-calculations.md (r2SCAN since v2022.10.28; PBEsol pre-relax then r2SCAN)
H1.caveat: No MP page states in prose which functional the OPTIMADE endpoint serves. The conclusion rests on emmet source code (main branch, fetched 2026-10-31), the r2SCAN thermo keys and the measured ~1% contraction. No r2SCAN-relaxed cell was fetched directly to compare, because the MP API needs a key. GGA cells for the other 9 ids were not fetched.

H2.question: Is mp-72 hcp alpha-Ti, and is it MP's GGA ground state?
H2.verdict: mp-72 is omega-Ti (P6/mmm, 191, 3 atoms). MP tags it 'Titanium - HP, omega / High pressure experimental phase'. It IS the GGA (gga_gga+u) hull ground state: E_hull = 0, E_f = 0. hcp alpha-Ti is mp-46 (P6_3/mmc, 194) at +0.0044 eV/atom in GGA (+0.0152 in r2SCAN). Calling mp-72 the 'Ti reference' is internally consistent with MP's GGA formation-energy reference, but it is not the ambient phase of Ti.

H3.question: Is mp-985806 (3-atom 'Al2Cu') the experimental theta-Al2Cu (I4/mcm)?
H3.verdict: No. mp-985806 is a fluorite-type (C1) Al2Cu. MP's archived GGA page lists it as Fm-3m 225 with no ICSD IDs and no tags, so it is hypothetical. The served (r2SCAN) cell is the same structure with a ~0.7% tetragonal distortion (I4/mmm 139). Its E_hull is 0 in gga_gga+u, gga_gga+u_r2scan and r2scan, so MP's hull treats it as the Al2Cu ground state. The experimental theta phase (khatyrkite, I4/mcm 140, 6-atom primitive cell, 6 ICSD IDs) is mp-998, at E_hull 0.0125 eV/atom (GGA) and 0.0476 (r2SCAN).

H4.question: Stereochemistry of the app's Alanine and Glucose SMILES
H4.verdict: Alanine 'CC(N)C(=O)O' leaves its only stereocentre (C-alpha) unspecified. It resolves to PubChem CID 602 (unspecified/DL), not L-alanine CID 5950 'C[C@@H](C(=O)O)N'. Glucose 'OC[C@H]1OC(O)[C@H](O)[C@@H](O)[C@@H]1O' fixes C2-C5 in the D-gluco configuration and leaves only the anomeric C1 unspecified. It resolves to CID 5793 D-glucose 'C([C@@H]1[C@H]([C@@H]([C@H](C(O1)O)O)O)O)O' (same InChIKey WQZGKKKJIJFFOK-GASJEMHNSA-N), not beta-D-glucopyranose CID 64689 'C([C@@H]1[C@H]([C@@H]([C@H]([C@@H](O1)O)O)O)O)O'.
